card.title: PS4 No power troubleshooting guide with standby voltage, southbridge, and PWM checks

source.title: PlayStation 4 No Power Troubleshooting and Component Identification

claims.statement: A bad southbridge can cause most of the time a no power situation.
claims.evidence: Text description on the left side.

claims.statement: Check +3,3 standby voltage on the power button and check the pulse when the power button is pressed.
claims.evidence: Text description and top right image pointing to connector.

claims.statement: Check for +3.3V voltage on the buttons. If no voltage is present Check the +3.3VSTBY for shorts
claims.evidence: Green box annotation pointing to connector.

claims.statement: A bad PWM controller can cause a no power situation.
claims.evidence: Text annotation pointing to RT5069A IC.

claims.statement: Check for shorts under the southbridge
claims.evidence: Green box annotation pointing to southbridge pads/area.

cautions: Check for burned or damages / missing components.
card.caveats: Does not provide specific schematic pinout measurements or exact resistance-to-ground expected values for shorts.
